args.summary: Deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 to production (us-east, us-west, eu-west) caused service-wide health check failures and an 18% error rate. In response, the service was rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release confirmed healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified: all regions now report v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate ~0.2%. v2.3.1 requires investigation before redeployment (a staging candidate v2.3.1-rc was also marked unhealthy).
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1, unhealthy across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled all production regions back to v2.3.0. Verified: service is healthy everywhere with error rate down to ~0.2%.
3. **Opened incident**: **INC-0001** (SEV2, checkout-api) describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and verification. On-call has been paged.

Recommendation: before redeploying, investigate the v2.3.1 failure — note the v2.3.1-rc staging candidate was also unhealthy, suggesting the issue exists upstream of the final build.
